correctness.rationale: The exact one-site energy minimization test covers all three spin alternatives and all five possible neighbour sums. The 9-state closed-walk transfer bijection yields B_n=trace(T^n) for every n>=3. Five exact symbolic determinant checks, 30 independent exhaustive finite-volume comparisons, renewal Perron equations and the squared-difference ground-state identity jointly establish the stated cases. Characteristic factorizations and renewal positivity prove unique leading eigenvalues. No finite test is used as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: The spin-1 Blume-Capel chain is a natural microscopic three-state ferromagnet. The result is a complete physical-parameter classification and an isolated strict growth-entropy maximum at the very coupling with only three actual ground states. Its nontrivial quartic is not a mere recount of equilibrium partition functions or a routine microscopic tie; the exponential separation quantifies landscape complexity and makes a meaningful distinction between energy minima and kinetic absorbing states.
